question: Where’s the nearest university to the west side of Pine Grove Zoo, Little Falls, MN?
sql: SELECT poi_name FROM pois AS university WHERE university.amenity = 'university' AND ST_X(ST_Centroid(university.geometry)) < ST_X(ST_Centroid(( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Pine Grove Zoo%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Little Falls%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%MN%' LIMIT 1 ))) ORDER BY ST_Distance(university.geometry::geography, ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Pine Grove Zoo%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Little Falls%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%MN%' LIMIT 1 )::geography) LIMIT 1;
